identityCaveats: Existing 1600-1815 interval is imported map coverage, not cultural lifespan. Wurundjeri is not interchangeable with all Kulin communities. Coranderrk included people from multiple communities.

Existing kurnai ID is retained, with proposed Gunaikurnai display name supported by community explanation. Do not back-project current corporation or legal recognition as a single ancient state. Imported 1815 end is false for a living culture.
Existing 1600-1815 observations are not cultural origin/extinction. Nation includes several local peoples. Exact historical state borders not asserted.

Retain imported wathaurong ID pending reconciliation with modern Wadawurrung preferred spelling and separate Wathaurong community-service organisation. Existing 1600-1815 dates are coverage only. Governance map is contemporary and explicitly changeable.
